lines.arrive: A room full of typewriters, and a monkey at each one.
lines.typing: They hit the keys at random. They will never stop.
lines.ask: Given forever, could they type Shakespeare?
lines.page_0: The best so far. Still nonsense.
lines.page_1: The best so far. One real word, by pure chance.
lines.page_2: The best so far. Two words, in the right order.
lines.found: There it is. To be, or not to be.
lines.found_2: Given forever, it had to happen. But none of them meant a word of it.
lines.leave_end: Most of it is noise. Forever is longer than it sounds.
lines.bananas: A crate of bananas. Forever takes a lot of bananas.
lines.best: Every page they type is checked. This is the best one so far: out of all of them, the one that looks most like English.
